Check movement interrupts and the ground probes, then read the five active-low joystick bits from CIA1 port A at $8FF3. Start the applicable moving state, or follow the neutral path at $9198 when all five bits are set.

Set movement mode three, clear jump step and phase counters, and queue sound effect priority two. Combine the active left and right stick bits with the camera's within-metatile X offset to select the jump trajectory.
Enter the neutral path when all five masked joystick bits are set. Update the idle counter and reach the frame selection at $91D0 or $91DD according to facing.
Check the terrain transition at $BEA4, then update the current horizontal movement using $02C4. At step $10 it clears movement mode and scroll speed before returning through the ground controls.
Stop horizontal motion, take the initial pose from $F990, and test separate active-low up and down bits to choose a vertical path. A nonzero $02C8 resumes the in-progress sequence at $9397.
Continue the mode-3 trajectory. Use $02C8 as its phase and $02C4 for its step, handle the phase-$FF exit back to the ground routine, and check fine Y offset before the special step-$1F transition.
Advance the mode-4 animation and movement. When the phase byte reaches $FF, clear this mode, and use $03C5 to decide whether to queue the follow-up animation and sound.

Test only the active-low fire bit from joystick port 2. The preceding falling-state logic permits this check from counts $1E to $31 if early fire and the other blocking flag are clear. A pressed fire button sets the parachute flag and selects the two sprite frames.
Stop camera motion and test joystick down. Releasing down restores the ordinary facing frame from $FC20 and returns to ground controls. Holding down continues the crouch processing.

Select a facing-dependent frame from $FC28, hold camera motion at zero and run the test at $C274. At step $14 restore the default movement mode.

Select the facing frame from $FC2E, hold camera motion at zero and call $C274. At step fifteen reset the mode and resume ground controls.
